scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); if (fs.existsSync('tsconfig.tsbuildinfo')) fs.rmSync('tsconfig.tsbuildinfo', { force: true }); ['packages', 'cli'].forEach(p => { if (fs.existsSync(p)) { if (p === 'cli') { const d = path.join(p, 'dist'); if (fs.existsSync(d)) fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }); const b = path.join(p, 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo'); if (fs.existsSync(b)) fs.rmSync(b, { force: true }); } else { fs.readdirSync(p).forEach(f => { const pkgDir = path.join(p, f); if (fs.existsSync(pkgDir) && fs.statSync(pkgDir).isDirectory()) { const d = path.join(pkgDir, 'dist'); if (fs.existsSync(d)) fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }); const b = path.join(pkgDir, 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo'); if (fs.existsSync(b)) fs.rmSync(b, { force: true }); } }); } } });"
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const del = p => { if (fs.existsSync(p)) fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }); }; del('node_modules'); del('package-lock.json'); ['packages', 'cli'].forEach(p => { if (fs.existsSync(p) && fs.statSync(p).isDirectory()) { fs.readdirSync(p).forEach(f => { del(path.join(p, f, 'node_modules')); }); } });"
scripts.ci: npm run lint:tsc && npm run lint:eslint && npm run build && npm test && npm run check-solid:diff && npm run depcruise
